verdict.rationale: Gide is a law firm. Its evidence does mention a technology platform and use of AI, so a client-facing AI-insights feature is a fair question to ask. The only AI evidence describes the firm using AI internally to speed up its own legal services. Nothing shows a product where users get AI-generated insights or suggestions from their own data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
